feeds.notes: This is a document download, NOT a live feed. Last-Modified: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 22:52:35 GMT. Members: '2026 General Results Summaries - OFFICIAL.xlsx' (1,068,257 bytes; sheets 'Statewide Total Ballots Cast', 'Statewide Candidates', 'Statewide Senate Odd', 'Statewide House', 'Statewide Judicial', 'Statewide Ballot Issue'), '2026 County General PbP - OFFICIAL.xlsx', '2026 County General PbP TBC - OFFICIAL.xlsx'. Each summary sheet is a wide human layout: row 1 a title, a row of office names in merged cells, a row of choice headers ('Harriet\nHageman (R)', 'Write-Ins', 'Overvotes', 'Undervotes'), then one row per county; a '-' means the county is not in that district. Statewide totals must be summed (or read from a totals row I did not look for). The files already say OFFICIAL: the page is headed '2026 Official General Election Results'. I do not know whether the same URLs carried unofficial numbers on election night, nor how often they were replaced.
